controls.title: Dependency inventory is reproducible
controls.description: Detect package managers, lockfiles and reproducible dependency inventory.
checks: Detect package managers, lockfiles and reproducible dependency inventory.
manual_questions: What concrete evidence supports: Dependency inventory is reproducible?
controls.pass_condition: A recognized dependency manifest and lock/integrity file are both present.
controls.partial_condition: A dependency manifest exists without a recognized lock/integrity file.
controls.fail_condition: No reproducible dependency inventory can be established from the inspected project.
controls.not_applicable_condition: Applicability engine records NOT_APPLICABLE with an explicit reason.
